title: doftiles
description: A personal dotfiles setup based with deployment, stow, and window manager.

content.heading: doftiles
content: A window manager setup based on herbstluftwm, almost ready for public use.

content.heading: From the README
content: configs for kine@home - Ubuntu deploys are as simple as `make install` now.
Deployed with GNU stow: the repo is cloned into ~/dots and its packages (bar, dunst, herbst, rofi, shell, vim) are adopted into $HOME.
